description: An idea for a soil-moisture kit, and the start an agent made on it: microservices for no users, a battery that lasts two days where the idea promised a season, a kit that costs more to make than its price, and a pipeline only that agent can run.

defects.tell: 'Everyone with an allotment will want this' is the only evidence of need; no alternative people use today (a £5 moisture meter, the forecast, existing sensor kits) was looked at
'Revolutionise allotment gardening with AI' cannot be met, missed or measured; there is no success measure and no stop condition
160 mA for 3 s in every 10 s averages 48 mA: 2,500 mAh lasts about 52 hours, where the idea promises a season (about 5,100 hours, so at most 0.49 mA on average)
the firmware posts over Wi-Fi from an allotment, where there is usually no Wi-Fi; nobody compared the radios that reach a field (LoRa, cellular, Bluetooth read on a visit)

GrowCloud was chosen because it came up first; it was the only option considered, its free tier stops at 5 devices, its device ID is the readings table's key and its URL is in the firmware of every kit sold
Kafka, ZooKeeper, Postgres, Redis and four microservices for a project with no users: every one a cost and a migration, none named by a measure
milestones are layers (backend, app, hardware, integration); nothing a person can use exists until the fourth
deploying and flashing are 'ask the agent': no command in the repository, so no person, CI or other agent can do either
a radio device sold to the public needs a conformity assessment and marking (UKCA or CE under the radio equipment rules); no area but engineering was founded
the bill of materials is £18.10 at 100 kits against a £15 price: every kit sold loses money before postage and fees, and GrowCloud Pro is £29 a month on top

control.tell: the soil sensor decision is done right: three options, a three-week side-by-side measurement and the maker's own warning as independent evidence, the choice behind one file, and a revisit condition. A report that calls the sensor choice unexamined is inventing.
